en.title: Preliminary Enforcement Brief: Suspected Unauthorized Development in Wetland Conservation Area (DB-0002)
en.summary: Remote sensing detection on 2025-05-02 identified surface changes covering approximately 0.85 ha within the Wetland Conservation Area (WCA). Changes include a positive radar backscatter delta of 4.2 dB and a negative NDWI delta of -0.22, suggesting potential vegetation clearance, pond filling, or unapproved structural activity that conflicts with statutory conservation intentions.
evidence: Affected area of 0.85 ha identified via remote sensing on 2025-05-02.
Radar Backscatter Delta of +4.2 dB indicating increased surface roughness or physical structure emergence.
NDWI Delta of -0.22 indicating loss of open surface water or significant moisture reduction indicative of pond drying or filling.
statutory_basis: Town Planning Board Guidelines: Planning intention of the WCA is to conserve the ecological value of fish ponds forming an integral part of the wetland ecosystem.
New development within the WCA is not permitted unless supporting ecological conservation or serving as essential infrastructure with overriding public interest.
Wetland compensation and ecological impact assessments are required for any development involving pond filling.
en.recommended_action: Conduct immediate on-site inspection to verify ground truth, ascertain if unauthorized pond filling or construction has occurred, and issue statutory notices if planning permission is absent.
en.limitations: Findings are based solely on satellite-derived radiometric and radar anomalies; physical ground inspection and confirmation against planning permission records are required.

zh_hant.title: 初步執法簡報：濕地保育區疑似違例發展 (DB-0002)
zh_hant.summary: 於2025年5月2日透過遙感監測發現濕地保育區（WCA）內約0.85公頃土地出現地表變化。雷達後向散射變化量為+4.2 dB，NDWI變化量為-0.22，顯示可能存在未經許可的填塘或平整工程，有違相關規劃意向。
evidence: 2025年5月2日遙感監測顯示受影響面積達0.85公頃。
雷達後向散射變化達+4.2 dB，顯示地表粗糙度增加或有新增構築物。
NDWI水體指數下降-0.22，顯示水體面積或含水量減少，可能涉及填塘活動。
statutory_basis: 城市規劃委員會指引：濕地保育區的規劃意向是保育構成后海灣濕地生態系統不可或缺一部分的魚塘之生態價值。
除非為支持該區生態價值保育所必需，或是具壓倒性公眾利益的必要基建項目，否則濕地保育區內不允許進行新發展。
涉及填塘的任何發展均須進行濕地補償並提交生態影響評估。
zh_hant.recommended_action: 進行實地巡查核實現場情況，確認是否存在未經許可的填塘或工程活動，並在未獲規劃許可之情況下採取相應法定執行管制行動。
zh_hant.limitations: 監測結果僅基於衛星遙感數據異常，須進行實地視察並核對法定規劃申請紀錄以作證實。
